reviews.comment: Overall a really nice person but her grading system was confusing. She would take points off for the most random things on homeworks or exams or writing projects. It was never consistent either. She also goes pretty fast during lectures and it feels very all over the place and can get hard to follow. She would often get sidetracked during class too

I took Dr. Shiu for the Honors section of 171. She made the class so fun! Way more proofs than your average Cal 1 class but she graded very generously. Content can be difficult but A cutoff is 80 so as long as you do your best you'll probably be fine.
Dr. Shiu is also super nice and accessible outside of class. You can tell she loves math.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Shiu's math 300 class was my favorite class I've taken this year. Her lectures are clear and engaging, and the tests are pretty easy if you understand how to write a proof. My only complaint is that the homework can be a bit much, but it's not too bad given that it's a writing intensive class.

Her thoughts are hard to follow and she makes mistakes often in class. Her TA and her would teach the material in different ways and then grade the test according to the strategy they had taught. I recommend another course if possible.

Fall 2023 Math 147: Textbook is the main problem. Does not go in depth enough and then lectures leave students high and dry as a result. "Use other materials" only stretches so far when the dept expects you to do things their way. Literally the only problem with the course was the book; not the prof. Even reviewers outside of TAMU say its bad lol.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall she was a nice person but a bad teacher. She made mistakes while writing stuff on the board and her notes are not clear. The homework and quizzes did not match up to what we were doing in the week . Would not take this class again.

I would recommend taking her class if you like being challenged in a good way! For honors, she sets the final grades with 80% as an A. You will have to attend office hours, but she's very helpful with any questions and responds quickly to emails if you need to schedule any appointments. I did take AP calc in high school and found it helped a lot.

Dr. Shiu was an okay professor. During lecture students would have to correct errors while working through example problems she provides. As to be expected, recitation was worth nearly nothing in the end, but was the most time consuming. Lots of homework, so don't fall behind. Exams were very hard. Lots of preparation, and LOTS of trig.

Sometimes gets ahead of herself when teaching but is willing to try and break it down so that we could understand. Homework and tests were tough. Often needed to go to office hours to figure out how to solve it. Very good class for people who enjoy math and want to learn about proofs. Exam corrections helped out but definitely a challenging class.

Professor Shiu is great, especially if you take her for Calc 1 H. The HW and Exams were tough as the class is proof-based. To make us enjoy learning instead of being stressed out by grades, she cut off for an A and 80%. She also offers exam corrections and oral exams, so to get an A in the class, you need to maintain a test average of about 70%.

Would heavily advise AGAINST taking her class. The homework is nothing like the tests or the quizzes, and during recitation even the TA couldn't do some of the problems assigned to us. Lectures were not very clear and mistakes were sometimes made, and over half of my class (including me) dropped her. Would not take her class again; BEWARE!

Dr. Shiu is a great professor who knows a lot & wants you to learn how to do the math yourself & not just give you the answer. For anyone math minded you will love this course. I however, am not math minded & this course was incredibly hard & I would not recommend to anyone unless you have to take 171 or really really like math.

PLEASE don't take this class. It will not benefit you in any way, you will either end up with a barely passing grade or dropping. She teaches as if we also have a math degree. There is SO much homework and quizzes every week. I had to teach myself everything and that wasn't enough. Ended up dropping it... waste of time!

Worst professor I've ever taken. She will take simple concepts, 'explain' it the most complicated way as if we are math majors. Homework is long, activity and quiz every week. Tests niche topics, not generous with grading. In office hours its obvious she wants you out of there. There are other profs that can get you to an A but def not this one.

She teaches 147 as if we are math majors, probably because she is so smart herself. If math is a weak trait of yours, just don't take her. I suggest knocking calculus out at a community college over the summer, college math can be overwhelming. She's a very tough grader and our midterm average was a 45. I personally had to Q drop.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Quite literally the worst professor I ever had. I considered myself pretty smart,took calc in highschool I took the class literally for a GPA boost just for it to drag my GPA. The TA has terrible breath. Over half my class q-dropped and I wish I could have too, but I have a scholarship. The work is not reflective of the tests and  unecessaily hard.

I loved this class! My only complaint was that she talked a bit fast at times and got ahead of herself, but other than that Dr. Shiu is a great professor. The class was difficult, but I don't think that was her doing -- it's just heavy material-wise. Pay attention because concepts build on each other and get help on HW when you have trouble ASAP!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor is very caring, and her tests are more straightforward than the homework. However, the homework itself is worth a lot of points, so be sure to be on top of your homework in order to maintain a good grade. I know the professor makes the exams very simple, but I still had overall trouble with the proofs

Great prof. Makes proofs digestible and the grading scale makes it so that you can take a hit on midterms as long as you put in time in HW, writing assignments, quizzes, and the final paper. Super nice and accessible, and provides review papers and practice tests. Not a hard class, but topics build on each other, so pay attention from the start.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Shiu is a fantastic professor. She teaches the material very well and is receptive to questions. If you do the weekly homework, the exams are very easy. There are weekly quizzes but the questions are identical to the ones shown in class. Overall, Dr. Shiu is very nice and she teaches the class well.

MATH220 is not your typical math class, it is a different approach to math than what most of us are used to. However, Dr. Shiu does care for students success and makes the class and test as fair as possible. So, even if you do not perform well in the tests, she always encourages her students not to give up and advises on how to do better.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Shiu was an interesting character to say the least... 1st day, she told us how her name sounds like the word shoe and went on about some random topics. Also, she stated that she had passed calculus once, so she should be okay to teach the course. I dont know about you, but that was not reassuring as a 1st time cal student. Please do stay away!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you are considering this prof, RUN!! She makes errors in lecture, doesnt explain the content well and expects you to be able to do complex problems from simpler, less confusing practice problems. If youve taken cal before in HS, youll be okay, but if not like me, youll begin to hate math in this class. Save the stress, dont take this prof!!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Prof. Shiu was a kind person; but, dont let that fool you. Her expectations were too high, as if we were math majors (we were biology). This was my first time with calculus and boy was it rough. Also, the prof would constantly make critical errors in lecture and students would have to correct her! Best advice: look for another prof or good luck...
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Take Professor Shiu for MATH147!! She is very approachable and knowledgeable. She encouraged participation a lot. Not going to lie, it was a fast paced and challenging course that required lots of studying and preparation.  I studied and did lots of practice problems and ended with 95%. If you put in work, you will be more than ok.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Extremely fast pace prof and class. If you didn't take calculus prior to this class you probably will fail.I work and study hard but have still failed all the exams. If you take this class, do ALL of the homework and start it at least 2/3 days before it is due. This class takes a lot of dedication which is hard to balance with hard science courses.
Professor Shiu is such a good professor. She cares about her students and is always available outside of class during office hours. I would definitely take her again if I could!

Shes a pretty good professor even though she does go fast in lecture. This class is definitely easier if you have somewhat of a background in calculus. Overall I think she does a good job of covering everything that is on the exams and gives plenty of examples in class. She also gives study guides before each exam that closely resemble the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: Let's be honest here, Professor Shiu is super nice and caring, but her class and recitation are big no no from me. Her exams are way harder than what we cover in class and oh did I mention there's a quiz and homework due every week? Mhm. If you do get this class just get ready to work...a lot.

I was not very impressed with Dr. Shiu. Her lectures are extremely fast passed and extremely confusing. With that being said, recitation helps a lot. Dr. Shiu is very nice and helpful if you go into her office hours. The homework is turned in at recitation, I usually prefer online homework because I feel that I learn the concepts better that way.

Dr. Shiu is one of the nicest profs out there! She will help you with the homework during her office hours and truly cares that you understand the material. VERY HARD CLASS but very nice prof. She talks a little fast and covers a lot of material.

She is all over the place in lecture. She is bad at explaining things and she talks way too fast which does not help at all. Lectures are nothing like homework, homework is nothing like quizzes or tests. If you have no calculus experience be prepared to put in a lot of extra work or find a tutor, just to get homework done.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Shiu has a wonderful teaching style. I took her 415 class and the best part was whenever we get to a proof of a theorem: instead of just writing it on the board for the class to copy down, she had us participate in writing it by asking us at each step what to do next. Go to her office hours! She definitely cares about whether or not you learn.
